name: New ~Maid-san no Gakkou~
source:
"Maid" has become a profession girls look up to. To nurture maids special school is created. Main character needs to find his love in this maids school. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“女仆”成了女孩们向往的职业。
为培养女仆，一所专门学校应运而生。
主人公必须在这所女仆学校里寻找自己的爱情。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
